verdict.rationale: Buzz has no llms.txt, which returns 404 (buzz-probe-1), but it does ship live agent-oriented docs. A root AGENTS.md agent guide, which CLAUDE.md points to, maps the repo and its crates. The repo mirrors vendor skills for four agent harnesses (.agents, .claude, .codex, .goose), and a packaged buzz-cli skill covers relay operations; probes confirm all of these are live. Missing for 10: llms.txt or an agent-readable docs index on buzz.xyz, AGENTS.md being scoped to codebase contributors rather than product users, and independent hands-on reports of agents consuming these docs.
